title: FastAPI dependency providers
scope: Six get_*_service factories wiring Session -> Repository -> Service for SupplierService, StaffService, DealerService, GradeService, DesignService, DesignGradeMapService. Each consumes Session = Depends(get_db) and returns the constructed service.

success_criteria.manual: Import dependencies; verify 6 callables exist and each takes a Session argument bound via Depends(get_db).
success_criteria.automated: Indirectly exercised by router-level integration tests (TC-033..TC-038).
success_criteria.definition_of_done: All 6 factories present; each returns the correct service type; no service constructed without an injected Session.

checkout_prompt: 'API dependencies wired — 6 service factories ready for routers.'
